name: Falcon 9 Block 5 | Crew-12
description: SpaceX Crew-12 is the twelfth crewed operational flight of a Crew Dragon spacecraft to the International Space Station as part of NASA's Commercial Crew Program.
weather: Cumulus Cloud Rule, Flight Through Precipitation

landing.description: The Falcon 9 first stage B1101 has landed back at the launch site after its 2nd flight.

timeline.label: Crew Access Arm Retract
timeline.description: Retraction of the crew access arm from the rocket

timeline.label: Dragon LES Arm
timeline.description: Dragon's launch escape system is armed
